workflow.name: watchtowr hunt intake
workflow.description: A watchtowr hunt, parsed by Tines and posted to the webhook of this workflow, becomes one case per customer and a war room named after the hunt. Each watchtowr tenant is matched to the IRIS customer whose WATCHTOWR_TENANT_ID key/value is its external_id, else to the customer of the same name; unknown tenants are reported, never created. Each case (SOC id = the hunt id, so a redelivered hunt reuses the open case) gets the exposed assets, typed from their service, and each asset only the CVEs watchtowr targeted on it (set untargeted_assets to "hunt" to give the assets without a list every CVE of the hunt); unknown CVEs are added to the catalogue. The cases are attached to the war room, which tracks every CVE of the hunt (CISA KEV first). The users in responders (user ids, in the Settings node) join the war room, and its members are notified. Needs, in Settings > MCP, iris_customers_list, iris_war_room_members_add and iris_war_room_vulnerabilities_track enabled. Expected payload: {hunt: {id, name, url, severity, tags}, vulnerabilities: [{cve, kev}], customers: [{name, external_id, assets: [{name, ip, port, service, version, cves}]}]}.

config.code:
# The open war room of the hunt, recognised by its marker, if a previous run made it
rooms = inputs['rooms'].get('war_rooms') if is_dict(inputs['rooms']) else []
rooms = rooms if is_list(rooms) else []
mine = [r for r in rooms if is_dict(r) and inputs['marker'] in str(r.get('description') or '')
        and not r.get('archived_at') and str(r.get('state') or '') != 'closed']
mine = sorted(mine, key=lambda r: r.get('war_room_id') or 0)
result = {'found': len(mine) > 0, 'war_room_id': mine[0]['war_room_id'] if mine else None}

# Item number `index` of `items`, or done
items = inputs['items'] if is_list(inputs['items']) else []
index = int(inputs['index'])
result = {'done': index >= len(items), 'item': items[index] if index < len(items) else None}

config.code:
# The planned assets the case does not hold yet (same name, any type)
names = set([str(a.get('asset_name') or '').strip().lower() for a in inputs['existing'] if is_dict(a)])
create = []
for asset in inputs['case']['assets']:
    if asset['asset_name'].strip().lower() not in names:
        create.append({k: v for k, v in asset.items() if k != 'cves' and v != ''})
result = create

# Item number `index` of `items`, or done
items = inputs['items'] if is_list(inputs['items']) else []
index = int(inputs['index'])
result = {'done': index >= len(items), 'item': items[index] if index < len(items) else None}

# Item number `index` of `items`, or done

index = int(inputs['index'])
result = {'done': index >= len(items), 'item': items[index] if index < len(items) else None}

# What was done for the customer, for the notification
done = inputs['done'] if is_list(inputs['done']) else []
case = inputs['case']
result = done + [{'customer': case['customer_name'], 'case_id': int(inputs['case_id']),
                  'created': int(inputs['created']) == 1,
                  'assets': len(case['assets']), 'assets_added': len(inputs['added']),
                  'findings': sum([len(f['asset_ids']) for f in inputs['findings']['findings']]),
                  'missing': inputs['findings']['missing']}]
